_doc: C9 FAST text-sanity sample (f384). A fixed route list swept at 390 and 1280 px by scripts/text_sanity_fast.mjs inside gates:built / postbuild (budget 60 s). It must cover: the three pages Kyle watches (/, /proof, /learning-loop), one page per seat (guest /scan, owner /app, pro /pro, agent /agents, enterprise /enterprise, partner /partners), every route family in the export (a family is a first path segment with 2+ routes under it, plus the root and one group for the single top-level pages), and every route an F1-style followup cap applies to. scripts/test_text_sanity_fast.mjs enumerates the families from the built export and fails if one is uncovered, so adding a family without adding it here fails the gate.
